input.quote: ARTICLE IV TERM I Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the "Initial Period"). The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
input.rationale:
Article IV commits Licensee to a 36-month initial term (renewable for seven years at Licensor's option) and the termination provisions elsewhere (Articles XIX–XXI, and the breach-based right in Articles III/IV) give Licensee no right to terminate for convenience at any notice period. Absence of any customer convenience right in a multi-year term is walk-away territory under the rule, so it fails both the preferred and fallback positions. Licensor has no express convenience right either, so the only gap is on our side. Proposed the model language: Licensee termination on thirty (30) days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination fee, inserted as a new clause IV of Article IV; 60 days' notice remains available as a fallback.</parationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.85

proposal.summary: Add Licensee right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article IV commits us to a 36-month term with no ability to exit for convenience, while Licensor may terminate immediately on any breach. We have added our standard right to terminate on thirty (30) days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty; if helpful we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: IV Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, without penalty, early-termination fee or other liability, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee any prepaid fees allocable to the period after the effective date of such termination.
